confidence_notes: City price indexes support the meal, coffee, and beer estimates; July hostel averages are listing-based. Cocktail is estimated at about 2.6 times a local draft beer, and wine by the glass at about 1.8 times beer. Hotel anchors are holistic estimates and less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No proxy city used; estimates draw on São Paulo-specific price indexes and hostel averages. Hotel estimates reflect São Paulo's large business-city market.
